# runpod_gpu_type (Data Source)

A single GPU type looked up by identifier.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_gpu_type" "rtx4090" {
  id = "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090"
}

output "vram_gb" {
  description = "VRAM of the looked-up GPU type, in GB."
  value       = data.runpod_gpu_type.rtx4090.memory
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) GPU type identifier, e.g. "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090".

### Read-Only

- `community` (Boolean) Available on community cloud.
- `memory` (Number) VRAM in GB.
- `name` (String) Human-readable GPU name.
- `pool` (String) Serverless GPU pool ID for runpod_serverless_endpoint.gpu_pools; null when not in a pool.
- `price_community` (Number) Community cloud price in USD/hr.
- `price_secure` (Number) Secure cloud price in USD/hr.
- `secure` (Boolean) Available on secure cloud.
